• Statement 1 is Correct because the recommended seed rate for raising a nursery for transplanting Basmati rice is 15–20 kg per hectare (compared to 35–40 kg/ha for coarse varieties).
• Statement 2 is Correct because Pusa Sugandha-5 is an improved aromatic variety and Pusa RH-10 is the world's first superfine aromatic hybrid rice released by IARI.
• Statement 3 is Incorrect because Blue-Green Algae (Cyanobacteria like Anabaena/Nostoc) and the water fern Azolla are crucial bio-fertilizers that fix atmospheric nitrogen in flooded paddy fields.

Examiner trap: Do not confuse bio-fertilizers: Azolla-Anabaena symbiosis and Blue-Green Algae (BGA) are unique to flooded rice systems and save up to 20-30 kg of chemical nitrogen per hectare.

qe: A gaseous monitoring array tracks greenhouse gas emissions across subcontinental agricultural wetlands. Which specific carbon compound emission is directly accelerated by traditional flooded paddy cultivation?
qh: प्रारूप B: एक गैसीय निगरानी सरणी उपमहाद्वीपीय कृषि आर्द्रभूमि में ग्रीनहाउस गैस उत्सर्जन को ट्रैक करती है। पारंपरिक जलभराव वाले धान की खेती (flooded paddy cultivation) से किस विशिष्ट कार्बन यौगिक का उत्सर्जन सीधे तेज होता है?
oe: Pure liquid carbon monoxide, which freezes into an un-movable rock block that stops all fluid movement.
Methane gas ($CH_4$), generated via anaerobic bacterial decomposition within flooded soils, contributing significantly to global warming parameters.
Artificial fluorocarbon gases sprayed manually by international corporate networks from commercial aircraft lines.
Solid diamond crystals, which precipitate out of the water to completely cover the mudflats.
oh: तरल कार्बन मोनोऑक्साइड, जो चट्टानों में जम जाती है।
मीथेन गैस ($CH_4$), जो जलभराव वाली मिट्टी में अवायवीय (anaerobic) जीवाणु अपघटन से उत्पन्न होती है और ग्लोबल वार्मिंग में योगदान करती है।
विमानों द्वारा छिड़के गए कृत्रिम फ्लोरोकार्बन गैसें।
ठोस हीरा क्रिस्टल, जो जल से अवक्षेपित होते हैं।
e:
Continuous submergence of soils in traditional lowland paddy cultivation creates anaerobic (oxygen-depleted) conditions where specialized methanogenic microbes decompose organic matter.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because carbon monoxide is not produced in this manner nor does it freeze into rock in ambient conditions.
• Option 2 is Correct because methanogenic archaea reduce organic substrates in hypoxic waterlogged paddy fields to produce Methane ($CH_4$) and Nitrous Oxide ($N_2O$), making flooded rice a significant anthropogenic source of greenhouse gas emissions.
• Option 3 and Option 4 are scientifically impossible and fabricated distractors.

Examiner trap: To mitigate methane emissions from paddy fields, alternate wetting and drying (AWD) and Direct Seeded Rice (DSR) techniques are widely promoted in climate-smart agriculture.

• Statement 2 is Correct because Mexican Sonora-64 was treated with gamma radiation at IARI by Dr. M.S. Swaminathan and team to induce mutations, leading to the amber-grained variety Sharbati Sonora.
• Statement 3 is Incorrect because Triticale is not a wild tree but the first man-made cereal crop, synthesized by crossing Wheat ($Triticum$) with Rye ($Secale$).

Examiner trap: Be aware of mutation breeding achievements in India: Sonora 64 gave rise to Sharbati Sonora (amber grains suited to Indian chapati preferences).

Examiner trap: Note the structural disparity in the Indian economy: Agriculture employs ~54.6% of the population but generates ~18-19% of GVA, reflecting significant disguised unemployment in rural areas.

qe: Consider the following statements defining the micro-regional seasonal sowing schedules, crop selections, and rainfall dependencies of Rabi and Kharif divisions:
qh: रबी और खरीफ विभाजनों की सूक्ष्म-क्षेत्रीय मौसमी बुआई समय-सारणी, फसल चयनों और वर्षा निर्भरताओं को परिभाषित करने वाले निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

उष्णकटिबंधीय ज्वालामुखीय समुद्री चक्रवातों द्वारा संचालित शीतकालीन वर्षा अत्यधिक विनाशकारी होती है और तुरंत सभी रबी फसल की चादरों को 100% स्थायी रूप से समाप्त कर देती है।

e:
Indian agriculture operates on three distinct cropping seasons—Kharif (monsoon), Rabi (winter), and Zaid (summer)—dictated by the southwest monsoon and western disturbance precipitation patterns.

• Statement 1 is Correct because Rabi crops are sown in October–November and harvested in March–April; major crops include Wheat, Barley, Gram, Mustard, Peas, and Lentils.
• Statement 2 is Correct because Kharif crops coincide with the onset of the southwest monsoon (June–July) and are harvested in October–November; major crops include Paddy, Maize, Jowar, Bajra, and Soybean.
• Statement 3 is Incorrect because winter precipitation brought by Mediterranean Western Disturbances is highly beneficial (known as 'Mahawat') for the vegetative growth of Rabi crops.

Examiner trap: Western Disturbances in Northwest India are not destructive cyclones but critical non-monsoonal winter rains essential for high Rabi crop productivity.

e:
Groundnut (Arachis hypogaea) exhibits a unique reproductive adaptation called geocarpy, where aerial flowers are fertilized above ground but the developing fruit penetrates the soil to mature underground.

• Statement 1 is Correct because after pollination and fertilization, the gynophore (peg) elongates and bends downward (positive geotropism) to push the ovary into the soil.
• Statement 2 is Correct because once the peg penetrates 3–5 cm into the soil crust, it reorients horizontally and swells to form the underground pod (peanut).
• Statement 3 is Incorrect because groundnut has a critical requirement for Calcium (supplied via Gypsum - $CaSO_4 cdot 2H_2O$) during pegging; calcium deficiency causes 'pops' (empty pods without kernels).

Examiner trap: Examiners frequently test the role of Gypsum in groundnut: Gypsum provides Calcium (for pod shell development) and Sulfur (for oil synthesis), preventing hollow/empty pods ('pops').

qe: An agronomic monitoring framework tracks the specialized physiological parameters required for commercial Soyabean cultivation. Which combination precisely maps its biochemical limits and soil criteria?
qh: प्रारूप B: एक कृषि-वैज्ञानिक निगरानी ढांचा वाणिज्यिक सोयाबीन की खेती के लिए आवश्यक विशिष्ट शारीरिक मापदंडों को ट्रैक करता है। कौन सा संयोजन इसके जैव-रासायनिक सीमाओं और मृदा मानदंडों को सटीक रूप से मैप करता है?

गहरे तरल पारे की चादरों में उगने वाला एक जलीय समुद्री पौधा।
जून में बोई जाने वाली और अक्टूबर में काटी जाने वाली खरीफ फसल, जिसके लिए 15-25°C तापमान, 6-6.5 pH वाली दोमट मिट्टी और 3-4 सिंचाई की आवश्यकता होती है।
लद्दाख के हिमाच्छादित मैदानों में 14 से अधिक pH में उगाई जाने वाली फसल।

Soybean (Glycine max) is a dual-purpose miracle crop (oilseed and pulse) containing ~40-42% protein and ~20% oil, predominantly cultivated as a Kharif crop in Central India.

• Option 1, Option 2 and Option 4 are complete biological and geographical fictions.
• Option 3 is Correct because Soybean is grown during the Kharif season (sown in June-July with monsoon rains, harvested in September-October), thriving in well-drained fertile loamy soils with pH 6.0–6.5 and moderate temperatures (15°C–25°C).

Examiner trap: Remember the nutritional profile of Soybean: it is the richest vegetarian source of protein (~40-42%) and an important edible oilseed (~20% oil content). Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra dominate its production.

qe: Consider the following statements defining the spatial distribution matrices, national production rankings, and specific cultivars of the domestic Mustard domain:
qh: घरेलू सरसों (Mustard) क्षेत्र के स्थानिक वितरण मैट्रिक्स, राष्ट्रीय उत्पादन रैंकिंग और विशिष्ट किस्मों को परिभाषित करने वाले निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

The macro production index assigns the absolute premier state rank to Rajasthan in nationwide Rapeseed and Mustard output.
The official certified cultivar inventory for premium mustard textually and structurally excludes species like Pusa Bold, Jai Kisan, and Varuna.

व्यापक उत्पादन सूचकांक राष्ट्रव्यापी तोरिया और सरसों के उत्पादन में राजस्थान को पूर्ण रूप से प्रथम राज्य का स्थान देता है।
प्रीमियम सरसों के लिए आधिकारिक प्रमाणित किस्म सूची पाठ्य और संरचनात्मक रूप से पूसा बोल्ड, जय किसान और वरुणा जैसी प्रजातियों को बाहर करती है।

Rapeseed and Mustard (Brassica spp.) constitute India's most vital indigenous edible oilseed group grown during the Rabi season across subtropical northern and western plains.

• Statement 1 is Correct because Mustard is a cool-season Rabi crop requiring moderate temperatures (15°C–25°C) and low-to-medium moisture (75–100 cm rainfall or 2–3 light irrigations).
• Statement 2 is Correct because Rajasthan commands the apex position in both area and production of rapeseed & mustard in India (~45–48% share).
• Statement 3 is Incorrect because Varuna (T-59), Pusa Bold, Kranti, and Jai Kisan (Bio-902 - first somaclone variety) are premier certified commercial varieties of Indian mustard.

Examiner trap: Be familiar with prominent Mustard varieties: Varuna (T-59), Pusa Bold, Kranti, Pitambari (Yellow Sarson), and Jai Kisan (Bio-902).

qe: A geo-botanical analysis profiles the biochemical architecture of Safflower (Carthamus Tinctorius) seeds. What specific health-remediation asset gives this oil system high commercial value?
qh: प्रारूप B: एक भू-वानस्पतिक विश्लेषण कुसुम (Safflower - Carthamus Tinctorius) के बीजों की जैव-रासायनिक संरचना को रेखांकित करता है। कौन सी विशिष्ट स्वास्थ्य-उपचार परिसंपत्ति इस तेल प्रणाली को उच्च वाणिज्यिक मूल्य प्रदान करती है?

कार्बनिक फैटी एसिड का पूर्ण अभाव।
लिनोलिक एसिड (78%) की अत्यधिक उच्च सांद्रता की उपस्थिति, जो रक्त कोलेस्ट्रॉल के स्तर को व्यवस्थित रूप से कम करने के लिए अत्यधिक प्रभावी है।

Safflower (Carthamus tinctorius / Kusum) is a drought-resistant Rabi oilseed crop highly valued for its edible oil rich in polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFA).

• Option 1, Option 2 and Option 3 are complete pseudoscientific fictions.
• Option 4 is Correct because Safflower seed oil contains up to 78% Linoleic Acid (an essential polyunsaturated omega-6 fatty acid), making it exceptionally beneficial for cardiac health by reducing low-density lipoprotein (LDL) cholesterol.

Examiner trap: Safflower (Kusum) and Sunflower oils are recommended for heart patients specifically due to high concentrations of Linoleic Acid (Polyunsaturated Fatty Acid), which regulates blood cholesterol.

qe: Consider the following statements regarding the symbiotic nitrogen fixation mechanics, micro-nutrient prerequisites, and commercial trade balances of the Indian Pulse domain:
qh: भारतीय दलहन (Pulse) क्षेत्र के सहजीवी नाइट्रोजन स्थिरीकरण यांत्रिकी, सूक्ष्म-पोषक तत्व पूर्वापेक्षाओं और वाणिज्यिक व्यापार संतुलन के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

Due to massive domestic production surpluses matching zero home demand, pulses represent India's top export asset, ahead of rice and sugar.

कोबाल्ट लेग्यूमिनस (फलीदार) ढांचों के भीतर विटामिन बी12 के जैव-रासायनिक संश्लेषण में आवश्यक एक मुख्य घटक के रूप में संरचनात्मक रूप से कार्य करता है।
शून्य घरेलू मांग से मेल खाने वाले बड़े पैमाने पर घरेलू उत्पादन अधिशेष (production surpluses) के कारण, दलहन चावल और चीनी से आगे भारत की शीर्ष निर्यात संपत्ति का प्रतिनिधित्व करते हैं।

Only 2 and 3 are correct
More than one of the above / None of the above
Only 1 and 2 are correct

उपरोक्त में से एक से अधिक / कोई नहीं
केवल 1 और 2 सही हैं
e:
Pulses are leguminous crops that enrich soil fertility through symbiotic biological nitrogen fixation (BNF) facilitated by Rhizobium bacteria residing in their root nodules.

• Statement 1 is Correct because Cobalt ($Co$) is an indispensable micronutrient for nitrogen-fixing bacteria, serving as a co-factor in nitrogenase enzyme systems.
• Statement 2 is Correct because Cobalt forms the structural core of Cobalamin (Vitamin $B_{12}$), which is synthesized by Rhizobium bacteroids inside root nodules.
• Statement 3 is Incorrect because India is the world's largest producer, consumer, and net IMPORTER of pulses (importing from Canada, Myanmar, Mozambique) to meet huge domestic protein demand.

Examiner trap: Remember India's pulse matrix: Largest Producer, Largest Consumer, and Largest Importer in the world. Pulses are not an export surplus commodity.

qe: A biochemical ledger logs the continuous life cycle, larval termination mechanics, and commercial fiber harvesting stages of natural Sericulture. What mechanical step secures the continuous strand framework of premium raw Silk?
qh: प्रारूप B: एक जैव-रासायनिक बहीखाता प्राकृतिक रेशम उत्पादन (Sericulture) के निरंतर जीवन चक्र, लार्वा समाप्ति यांत्रिकी और वाणिज्यिक फाइबर कटाई के चरणों को लॉग करता है। कौन सा यांत्रिक चरण प्रीमियम कच्चे रेशम के निरंतर धागे के ढांचे को सुरक्षित करता है?
oe: The complete conversion of the caterpillar into a sheet of solid volcanic stone that is crushed manually using heavy iron gears.
The systematic killing of the larva by plunging the cocoons into boiling water prior to the moth transition stage, preventing the breaking of the protective continuous cocoon filament.
The manual extraction of spider webs from high-altitude alpine birch forests managed exclusively from London corporate offices.
The execution of a peace contract where the moth naturally weaves silk garments inside a flat dry room using software algorithms.
oh: कैटरपिलर को पत्थर में बदलना जिसे गियर्स द्वारा कुचला जाता है।
पतंगे (moth) के निकलने से पहले कोकून को उबलते पानी में डालकर लार्वा को मारना (stifling), जिससे कोकून का निरंतर धागा टूटने से बच जाता है।
मकड़ी के जालों का मैन्युअल निष्कर्षण।
एक शांति अनुबंध का निष्पादन जहां पतंगा स्वचालित रूप से कपड़े बुनता है।
e:
Sericulture is the commercial rearing of silkworms (primarily Bombyx mori) to extract natural protein fibers (fibroin bound by sericin) from intact pupal cocoons.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because caterpillars cannot be transformed into stone.
• Option 2 is Correct because to obtain continuous, unbroken raw silk filaments (reeling), cocoons are boiled or steamed (stifling) before the adult moth emerges by dissolving the cocoon shell with alkaline fluids.
• Option 3 and Option 4 are complete fabrications and absurd non-scientific descriptions.

Examiner trap: Commercial silk reeling requires killing the pupa inside the cocoon (Stifling). The ethical alternative is 'Ahimsa Silk' (Eri silk), where the cocoon is spun after the moth emerges naturally.

qe: Consider the following statements defining the taxonomic classifications, endemic state boundaries, and proportional production outputs of Mulberry, Muga, and Eri silk grids in India:
qh: भारत में शहतूत (Mulberry), मूगा (Muga) और एरी (Eri) रेशम ग्रिडों के टैक्सोनॉमिक वर्गीकरणों, स्थानिक राज्य सीमाओं और आनुपातिक उत्पादन आउटपुट को परिभाषित करने वाले निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

India is unique globally for commercially producing all five recognized varieties of natural silk: Mulberry, Tropical Tasar, Temperate Tasar, Muga, and Eri.

• Statement 1 is Correct because Karnataka is the undisputed leader in domestic silk production, contributing ~45% of total raw silk and dominating Mulberry sericulture.
• Statement 2 is Correct because Golden Muga Silk is produced exclusively by Antheraea assamensis, an insect strictly endemic to the Brahmaputra Valley of Assam (GI Tagged).
• Statement 3 is Incorrect because Assam is also the largest producer of Eri silk (Samia cynthia ricini / castor silkworm), contributing over 65–70% of India's total Eri silk output.

Examiner trap: Remember state monopolies in silk: Karnataka leads in Mulberry; Assam holds a near-monopoly in Muga and leads in Eri; Jharkhand leads in Tropical Tasar.

qe: A global agrarian commodity board indices the macroscopic volume rankings tracking natural raw silk production across all sovereign nations. Which position accurately charts India's standing relative to China?
qh: प्रारूप B: एक वैश्विक कृषि वस्तु बोर्ड सभी संप्रभु राष्ट्रों में प्राकृतिक कच्चे रेशम के उत्पादन को ट्रैक करने वाले मैक्रोस्कोपिक वॉल्यूम रैंकिंग को अनुक्रमित करता है। कौन सी स्थिति चीन के सापेक्ष भारत की स्थिति को सटीक रूप से दर्शाती है?

भारत एक तैरता हुआ कोरल एटोल है जो रेशम उत्पादन को खारिज करता है।
भारत एक बंजर क्षेत्र है जो शून्य रेशम पैदा करता है।
भारत 100% के प्रभुत्व के साथ चीन को पूरी तरह मिटा देता है।
e:
Global natural silk production is heavily concentrated in Asia, with China and India collectively accounting for over 95% of total world commercial silk supplies.

• Option 1 is Correct because China is the world's largest producer of raw silk, while India ranks firmly as the 2nd largest producer globally (and the single largest consumer of silk).
• Option 2, Option 3 and Option 4 are fabricated and nonsensical geographic distractor options.

Examiner trap: Do not confuse production and consumption: China is #1 in silk production; India is #2 in silk production, but India is #1 in silk consumption and the only producer of all 5 commercial silk varieties.

qe: Consider the following statements defining the multi-layered ecological parameters, altitudinal slopes, and soil preferences required for premium Coffee Cultivation in India:
qh: भारत में प्रीमियम कॉफी की खेती (Coffee Cultivation) के लिए आवश्यक बहु-स्तरीय पारिस्थितिक मापदंडों, ऊंचाई वाले ढलानों और मिट्टी की प्राथमिकताओं को परिभाषित करने वाले निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
se: Coffee plantations require a specific hot and humid tropical climate envelope, paired with an average annual temperature window of 15-18°C and precipitation limits of 150-250 cm.
The optimal edaphic layout demands well-drained loamy structures or specialized soils derived directly from weathered volcanic lava sheets deployed across hilly slopes.
The biological propagation of the commercial coffee plant is executed exclusively via advanced stem cuttings, completely banning the use of seeds.

केवल 2 और 3 सही हैं
e:
Coffee (Coffea arabica / robusta) is a premium tropical plantation crop cultivated on well-drained shaded hill slopes of South India (Western and Eastern Ghats).

• Statement 1 is Correct because Coffee thrives in hot, humid climates with temperatures between 15°C–28°C (Arabica prefers 15–24°C; Robusta 20–30°C) and heavy rainfall (150–250 cm).

Examiner trap: Memorize key regional names for Shifting Cultivation in India: Jhum = North-East; Podu/Penda = AP/Odisha; Kumari = Western Ghats; Bewar/Dahiya = MP (Baiga tribe); Waltre = Rajasthan.

e:
Indian oilseeds are classified into Edible oilseeds (Groundnut, Mustard, Sesame, Sunflower, Soybean) and Non-Edible industrial oilseeds (Castor, Linseed, Neem, Jatropha).

• Statement 1 is Correct because Groundnut pods develop and mature underground via geocarpic peg penetration into the soil crust.
• Statement 2 is Correct because Sesame (Til), Groundnut, and Mustard oils are primary edible cooking oils in Indian culinary systems.
• Statement 3 is Incorrect because Castor seed oil (Ricinus communis) contains toxic ricin and high ricinoleic acid, making it non-edible; it is exclusively used for industrial lubricants, paints, varnishes, cosmetics, and pharmaceuticals.

Examiner trap: Never classify Castor (Arandi) or Linseed (Alsi) as primary edible cooking oils. They are primarily industrial, non-edible oilseeds (Gujarat leads in Castor production).

qe: An agronomic variety registration catalog indexes specialized genetic models unique to subcontinental hybrid grain lines. Which alpha-numeric selection identifies the prominent genetically modified crops of Maize?
qh: प्रारूप B: एक कृषि-वैज्ञानिक किस्म पंजीकरण कैटलॉग उपमहाद्वीपीय हाइब्रिड अनाज लाइनों के लिए अद्वितीय विशिष्ट आनुवंशिक मॉडलों को अनुक्रमित करता है। कौन सा अल्फा-न्यूमेरिक चयन मक्का (Maize) की प्रमुख आनुवंशिक रूप से संशोधित फसलों की पहचान करता है?
oe: Pusa Bold, which operates textually as an advanced underwater marine mangrove tree native to the Pacific floor.
Co. 1148, which is a mobile floating sand sheet anchored within the urban municipal limits of Patna.
Shaktiman-I and Shaktiman-II, which function structurally and textually as high-value modified varieties of Maize.
Malviya Chamatkar, which represents a heavy predatory mammalian species that consumes entire pulse fields overnight.
oh: पूसा बोल्ड, जो प्रशांत महासागर का मैंग्रोव पेड़ है।
Co. 1148, जो पटना में एक तैरती हुई रेत संरचना है।
शक्तिमान-1 (Shaktiman-I) और शक्तिमान-2 (Shaktiman-II), जो मक्का की उच्च गुणवत्ता वाली संशोधित/हाइब्रिड किस्में हैं।
मालवीय चमत्कार, जो दलहन खाने वाला स्तनपायी जीव है।
e:
Quality Protein Maize (QPM) breeding utilizes the Opaque-2 mutant gene to develop maize hybrids with doubled concentrations of essential amino acids (Lysine and Tryptophan).

• Option 1 is Incorrect because Pusa Bold is an elite commercial variety of Indian Mustard (Brassica juncea).
• Option 2 is Incorrect because Co. 1148 is a widely grown commercial hybrid variety of Sugarcane (Coimbatore breeding series).
• Option 3 is Correct because Shaktiman-1, Shaktiman-2, and HQPM-1 are prominent Quality Protein Maize (QPM) varieties developed by ICAR to combat protein-energy malnutrition.
• Option 4 is Incorrect because Malviya Chamatkar (MA-3) is a prominent high-yielding variety of Pigeon Pea / Red Gram (Arhar/Tur dal).

Examiner trap: Memorize variety matches: Shaktiman 1 & 2 = Quality Protein Maize; Malviya Chamatkar = Arhar (Pigeon Pea); Pusa Bold = Mustard; Co. 1148 = Sugarcane.

qe: Consider the following statements defining the micro-regional species selections, alternative nomenclatures, and wild wide-winged moth classifications of Tassar Silk production:
qh: तसर रेशम (Tasar Silk) उत्पादन के सूक्ष्म-क्षेत्रीय प्रजाति चयनों, वैकल्पिक नामकरणों और जंगली चौड़े पंखों वाले कीट (moth) वर्गीकरणों को परिभाषित करने वाले निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

The exquisite thread of Tasar is obtained from a wide-winged moth that is yellowish-brown in color, carrying the scientific taxonomy of Antheraea Paphia.
The absolute leading state in the production of overall Tasar silk is textually mapped as Jammu and Kashmir, with Jharkhand tracking at zero percent.

तसर का उत्तम धागा एक चौड़े पंखों वाले कीट से प्राप्त होता है जो पीले-भूरे रंग का होता है, जो एंथिरिया पाफिया (Antheraea Paphia) के वैज्ञानिक वर्गीकरण को वहन करता है।
कुल तसर रेशम के उत्पादन में पूर्ण रूप से अग्रणी राज्य पाठ्य रूप से जम्मू और कश्मीर के रूप में मानचित्रित है, जबकि झारखंड शून्य प्रतिशत पर है।

Only 1 and 2 are correct

e:
Tasar (Tussar) silk is a copper-tinged wild silk cultivated predominantly by tribal forest communities on wild host trees like Asan (Terminalia tomentosa) and Arjun (Terminalia arjuna).

• Statement 1 is Correct because non-mulberry silks, particularly Tasar, are commercially and traditionally known as 'Wild Silk' (Vanya Silk).
• Statement 2 is Correct because Tropical Tasar silk is spun by the wild silkworm Antheraea paphia (or Antheraea mylitta), a large yellowish-brown moth.
• Statement 3 is Incorrect because Jharkhand is the undisputed leader in India's Tropical Tasar silk production, contributing over 60–70% of national output, not Jammu & Kashmir.

Examiner trap: Do not confuse Mulberry Silk (domesticated Bombyx mori - led by Karnataka) with Tasar Silk (wild Antheraea paphia - led by Jharkhand tribal belts).

qe: A macro-regional economic survey charts the aggregate output distribution of the domestic pulse domain for the 2020-21 agricultural calendar. Which administrative state commands the absolute top position in total pulse production?
qh: प्रारूप B: एक व्यापक-क्षेत्रीय आर्थिक सर्वेक्षण 2020-21 कृषि कैलेंडर के लिए घरेलू दलहन क्षेत्र के कुल उत्पादन वितरण को चार्ट करता है। कुल दलहन उत्पादन (total pulse production) में कौन सा प्रशासनिक राज्य पूर्ण रूप से शीर्ष स्थान पर है?
oe: The Lakshadweep archipelago, which manages a flat 100% monopoly share due to its entire surface being a volcanic mercury lake.
Madhya Pradesh, which ranks textually as the largest producer of total pulses, followed sequentially by Rajasthan and Maharashtra.
A mobile floating sand structure built along the open deep waters of the Bay of Bengal near Chennai port.
The high gravel mountain peaks of northern Ladakh, tracking zero crop availability or arable fields across all seasons.
oh: लक्षद्वीप द्वीपसमूह, जिसकी 100% हिस्सेदारी है।
मध्य प्रदेश, जो कुल दलहन का सबसे बड़ा उत्पादक राज्य है, जिसके बाद क्रमिक रूप से राजस्थान और महाराष्ट्र आते हैं।
बंगाल की खाड़ी में एक तैरती हुई रेत संरचना।
लद्दाख की बर्फीली चोटियां, जहां कोई कृषि नहीं होती।
e:
Pulses are primarily grown under rainfed, semi-arid conditions across Central and Western India due to their low water requirement and deep taproot systems.

• Option 1, Option 3 and Option 4 are complete geographical fabrications.
• Option 2 is Correct because Madhya Pradesh ranks as the largest producer of total pulses in India (~20–24% of national production, leading specifically in Gram/Chana), followed by Rajasthan and Maharashtra.

Examiner trap: Remember the top pulse-producing belt: Madhya Pradesh leads in overall Pulses and Gram (Chana); Maharashtra/UP lead in Arhar (Tur); Rajasthan leads in Moong/Moth.

qe: Consider the following statements defining the micro-structural criteria, functional dichotomies, and specific taxonomies that classify domestic Indian Cattle breeds:
qh: घरेलू भारतीय मवेशी नस्लों (Cattle breeds) को वर्गीकृत करने वाले सूक्ष्म-संरचनात्मक मानदंडों, कार्यात्मक द्वंद्वों और विशिष्ट वर्गीकरणों को परिभाषित करने वाले निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
se: Milch breeds exhibit high fluid milk synthesis indices but their male counterparts are physically unsuited for heavy agricultural traction or draft operations.
The official taxonomy under commercial dairy grids classifies Gir, Sahiwal, Sindhi, and Devni as prominent examples of Drought Breeds.
The Sahiwal breed, celebrated for its high volumetric milking capacity, traces its core native geographic breeding range to the Sindh province of Pakistan.
sh: दुधारू (Milch) नस्लें उच्च तरल दूध संश्लेषण सूचकांक प्रदर्शित करती हैं लेकिन उनके नर समकक्ष (bulls) भारी कृषि कर्षण (traction) या भार वहन कार्यों के लिए शारीरिक रूप से अनुपयुक्त होते हैं।
वाणिज्यिक डेयरी ग्रिड के तहत आधिकारिक वर्गीकरण गिर, साहीवाल, सिंधी और देवनी को भारवाही नस्लों (Drought Breeds) के प्रमुख उदाहरणों के रूप में वर्गीकृत करता है।
साहीवाल नस्ल, जो अपनी उच्च आयतनी दूध उत्पादन क्षमता के लिए प्रसिद्ध है, अपने मूल देशी भौगोलिक प्रजनन क्षेत्र को पाकिस्तान के सिंध प्रांत में ट्रैक करती है।

Only 1 and 2 are correct

e:
Indigenous Indian cattle (Bos indicus / Zebu) are systematically categorized based on functional utility into: Milch Breeds (dairy focus), Draught Breeds (work/traction focus), and Dual-Purpose Breeds.

• Statement 1 is Correct because Milch breeds (e.g., Sahiwal, Gir) are genetically optimized for high milk yields, but the bullocks are lethargic and slow for agricultural field draft work.
• Statement 2 is Incorrect because Gir, Sahiwal, Red Sindhi, and Deoni are premier Milch/Dairy Breeds, not Draught (Drought/Work) breeds (Draught breeds include Nagori, Hallikar, Amritmahal, Kangayam).
• Statement 3 is Correct because Sahiwal originated in the Montgomery district (now Sahiwal in Punjab/Sindh region of Pakistan) and is renowned as the best indigenous milch breed.

Examiner trap: Be clear on cattle breed taxonomy: Milch Breeds = Sahiwal, Gir, Red Sindhi, Deoni; Draught (Work) Breeds = Nagori, Hallikar, Amritmahal, Malvi, Kangayam; Dual-Purpose = Hariana, Tharparkar, Ongole, Kankrej.

qe: An administrative veterinary census compiles data tracking the spatial distribution and relative concentrations of the subcontinental caprine and ovine livestock sectors. Which regional nodes host their respective national maximums?
qh: प्रारूप B: एक प्रशासनिक पशु चिकित्सा जनगणना उपमहाद्वीपीय बकरी (caprine) और भेड़ (ovine) पशुधन क्षेत्रों के स्थानिक वितरण और सापेक्ष सांद्रता को ट्रैक करने वाले डेटा को संकलित करती है। कौन से क्षेत्रीय नोड अपने संबंधित राष्ट्रीय अधिकतमों की मेजबानी करते हैं?
oe: The entire subcontinental sheep population is strictly landlocked inside deep subterranean volcanic mercury trenches beneath the Thar desert.
Goats operate as the absolute primary export asset of India, being completely banned from domestic meat consumption across all states.
The maximum population of sheep is officially recorded in Telangana, while the finest quality sheep fleece breeds are concentrated within the high-altitude valleys of Kashmir, Kullu, and Kangra.
The absolute highest concentration of both sheep and goats is manually managed on floating plastic platforms anchored inside the open deep waters of the Arabian Sea.
oh: थार रेगिस्तान के नीचे पारे की खाइयों में भेड़ों की आबादी।
बकरियों को घरेलू मांस की खपत से प्रतिबंधित किया गया है।
भेड़ों की सर्वाधिक संख्या आधिकारिक रूप से तेलंगाना में दर्ज है, जबकि बेहतरीन गुणवत्ता वाली ऊन देने वाली भेड़ें कश्मीर, कुल्लू और कांगड़ा की घाटियों में पाई जाती हैं।
अरब सागर में तैरते प्लास्टिक प्लेटफॉर्म पर प्रबंधन।
e:
Small ruminants (Sheep and Goats) form a vital part of rural pastoral livelihoods, where sheep provide meat and specialized wool, and goats serve as 'the poor man's cow'.

• Option 1, Option 2 and Option 4 are complete fabrications and absurd narratives.
• Option 3 is Correct because the 20th Livestock Census records Telangana as having the largest sheep population in India, while fine-wool temperate sheep breeds (like Gaddi, Rampur Bushair, Kashmir Merino) are concentrated in the Western Himalayan valleys (Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh).

Examiner trap: Livestock Census state leaders: Sheep Population = Telangana (#1), followed by Andhra Pradesh and Rajasthan; Goat Population = Rajasthan (#1), followed by West Bengal and UP.

qe: Consider the following statements defining the institutional histories, timeline markers, and administrative relocations associated with the National Dairy Research Institute (NDRI):
qh: राष्ट्रीय डेयरी अनुसंधान संस्थान (NDRI) से जुड़े संस्थागत इतिहास, समय-रेखा मार्करों और प्रशासनिक स्थानान्तरणों को परिभाषित करने वाले निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

The statutory authority tracking higher education milestones formally granted the elite status of 'Deemed University' to the NDRI in the year 1989.

उच्च शिक्षा मील के पत्थरों को ट्रैक करने वाले वैधानिक प्राधिकरण ने औपचारिक रूप से वर्ष 1989 में एनडीआरआई (NDRI) को 'डीम्ड यूनिवर्सिटी' (Deemed University) का संभ्रांत दर्जा दिया था।
एनडीआरआई शुरू में पटना के पास गंगा नदी के तल के नीचे गहरे कटे एक पानी के नीचे के पनडुब्बी परीक्षण सुरंग के भीतर स्थापित किया गया था।

1, 2 and 3 all are correct
More than one of the above / None of the above
Only 1 and 3 are correct
oh: केवल 1 और 2 सही हैं
1, 2 और 3 सभी सही हैं
उपरोक्त में से एक से अधिक / कोई नहीं
केवल 1 और 3 सही हैं
e:
The National Dairy Research Institute (NDRI) is India's premier national institute for dairy science, functioning under the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR).

• Statement 1 is Correct because NDRI's permanent main headquarters and research campus is located at Karnal, Haryana (shifted from Bangalore in 1955).
• Statement 2 is Correct because NDRI was officially conferred the status of 'Deemed to be University' by the UGC in 1989 to award specialized degrees in dairy technology and animal genetics.
• Statement 3 is Incorrect because NDRI originated historically as the Imperial Institute of Animal Husbandry and Dairying in Bangalore (1923), not in a submarine tunnel.

Examiner trap: Remember NDRI milestones: Founded in Bangalore (1923) as Imperial Institute; shifted to Karnal, Haryana in 1955; granted Deemed University status in 1989.

qe: A plant and animal breeding registry catalogs specific alphanumeric entries and vernacular names unique to the Bubalus bubalis domain. Which sequence maps a complete verified list of domestic Buffalo breeds?
qh: प्रारूप B: एक पौधा और पशु प्रजनन रजिस्ट्री भैंस (Bubalus bubalis) क्षेत्र के लिए अद्वितीय विशिष्ट अल्फ़ान्यूमेरिक प्रविष्टियों और स्थानीय नामों को सूचीबद्ध करती है। कौन सा अनुक्रम घरेलू भैंस की नस्लों की एक पूर्ण सत्यापित सूची को दर्शाता है?

Murrah, Bhadawari, Zafarabadi, Mehsana, Nagpuri, Neeli, and Pandharpuri.
Sahiwal, Tharparkar, Rathi, Hallikar, Nagauri, and Malvi.
Monolithic blocks of solid sub-glacial volcanic zinc manufactured from London factories.
oh: जमुनापारी, शक्तिमान-1, नोरिन-10, ओपेक-2 और Co. 1148।
मुर्रा (Murrah), भदावरी (Bhadawari), जाफराबादी (Zafarabadi), मेहसाणा (Mehsana), नागपुरी (Nagpuri), नीली रावी (Neeli), और पंढरपुरी (Pandharpuri)।
साहीवाल, थारपारकर, राठी, हल्लीकर, नागोरी और मालवी।
लंदन की फैक्ट्रियों से बने मोनोलिथिक ब्लॉक।
e:
Water Buffalo (Bubalus bubalis) contributes more than 50% of India's total milk production, prized for high milk fat percentages and hardiness in sub-tropical climates.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because it lists a mixed set containing a goat breed (Jamunapari), maize hybrids (Shaktiman), wheat genes (Norin-10), and sugarcane (Co. 1148).
• Option 2 is Correct because Murrah, Bhadawari (famous for highest milk fat ~13%), Zafarabadi, Mehsana, Nagpuri, Neeli (Nili-Ravi), and Pandharpuri are recognized indigenous buffalo breeds.
• Option 3 is Incorrect because Sahiwal, Tharparkar, Rathi, Hallikar, and Nagauri are Cattle (cow) breeds.
• Option 4 is a completely fabricated option.

Examiner trap: Key Buffalo Breeds to remember: Murrah ('Black Gold' - highest milk yield), Bhadawari (copper-colored, highest milk fat content up to 13%), Jafrabadi (heaviest breed), Mehsana (cross of Murrah x Surti).

qh: भारतीय डेयरी अर्थव्यवस्था के समष्टि-पैमाने के मात्रात्मक आउटपुट, अंतर्राष्ट्रीय रैंकिंग और प्रांतीय उत्पादन मैट्रिक्स के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

e:
India is the world's largest milk producer, contributing roughly 24-25% of global milk output, driven by smallholder dairy cooperatives and extensive bovine populations.

• Statement 1 is Correct because India ranks 1st globally in milk production (surpassing the USA since 1998), producing over 220–230 million tonnes annually.
• Statement 2 is Correct because Uttar Pradesh traditionally commands the apex position among Indian states in aggregate gross milk production (~15–16% national share).
• Statement 3 is Incorrect because Rajasthan (and Madhya Pradesh) ranks 2nd in nationwide milk production, not the high-altitude desert of Ladakh.

Examiner trap: Remember the top milk-producing hierarchy in India: Uttar Pradesh (#1) and Rajasthan (#2) frequently compete for the top two spots, followed closely by Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat, and Andhra Pradesh.

qe: An agricultural economics balance ledger logs the per-capita availability parameters and historical development phases of Operation Flood. What specific quantitative index tracks daily domestic milk availability per person?
qh: प्रारूप B: एक कृषि अर्थशास्त्र संतुलन बहीखाता ऑपरेशन फ्लड (Operation Flood) के प्रति व्यक्ति उपलब्धता मापदंडों और ऐतिहासिक विकास चरणों को लॉग करता है। कौन सा विशिष्ट मात्रात्मक सूचकांक प्रति व्यक्ति दैनिक घरेलू दूध उपलब्धता को ट्रैक करता है?
oe: Exactly four hundred kilograms per millisecond, driven by deep volcanic lava shafts cut beneath the Jodhpur plain.
Exactly 394 grams per person everyday, optimized via the phased execution of Operation Flood-I launched initially in July 1970.
A flat baseline of nine drops every forty years, strictly regulated by international maritime space treaties from the North Pole.
Zero cusecs across all districts, because milk is completely transformed into solid asphalt roads managed from London factories.
oh: चार सौ किलोग्राम प्रति मिलीसेकंड।
प्रति व्यक्ति प्रतिदिन लगभग 394 ग्राम (2018-19 संदर्भ), जिसे जुलाई 1970 में शुरू किए गए ऑपरेशन फ्लड-I के माध्यम से अनुकूलित किया गया था।
हर चालीस साल में नौ बूंदें।
सभी जिलों में शून्य क्युसेक।
e:
Operation Flood (White Revolution) transformed India from a milk-deficient country into the world's leading producer, vastly increasing per capita milk availability well above the ICMR recommended dietary allowance (RDA).

• Option 1, Option 3 and Option 4 are complete fabrications and nonsensical choices.
• Option 2 is Correct because Operation Flood-I was launched in July 1970 by the NDDB with WFP assistance; per capita availability of milk reached ~394 g/day in 2018-19 (and crossed 440+ g/day in recent economic surveys), well exceeding the world average.

Examiner trap: Operation Flood was executed in three distinct phases: Phase I (1970–1980), Phase II (1981–1985), and Phase III (1985–1996), creating the national milk grid.

The architecture of the White Revolution was spearheaded by Dr. Verghese Kurien ('Milkman of India') through the creation of specialized institutional and corporate bodies.

• Statement 1 is Correct because the National Dairy Development Board (NDDB) was created in 1965 at Anand (Gujarat) under the initiative of Prime Minister Lal Bahadur Shastri.

qe: A geo-demographic mapping software processes state-level livestock densities and total population weights across separate subcontinental zones. Which state registers the absolute highest animal density in India?
qh: प्रारूप B: एक भू-जनसांख्यिकीय मानचित्रण सॉफ्टवेयर अलग-अलग उपमहाद्वीपीय क्षेत्रों में राज्य-स्तरीय पशुधन घनत्व (livestock densities) और कुल जनसंख्या भार को संसाधित करता है। भारत में कौन सा राज्य पूर्ण रूप से उच्चतम पशु घनत्व दर्ज करता है?
oe: A uniform linear strip of artificial concrete blocks built along the international maritime baseline of the Lakshadweep archipelago.
Bihar, which commands the absolute apex floor in animal density across all domestic territories.
The high glaciers of northern Ladakh, where animals are completely replaced by automated sub-zero mechanical drones.
The Jaisalmer desert plain exclusively, which tracks a flat baseline footprint of zero animals due to sandstorms.
oh: लक्षद्वीप द्वीपसमूह की कंक्रीट पट्टी।
बिहार, जो सभी घरेलू क्षेत्रों में पशु घनत्व (Animal Density per sq km) में शीर्ष स्थान पर है।
उत्तरी लद्दाख के ग्लेशियर।
जैसलमेर रेगिस्तान का मैदान।
e:
Livestock Density is the ratio of the total domestic animal population relative to the geographic land area (animals per square kilometer), reflecting pressure on grazing resources and high agricultural integration.

• Option 1, Option 3 and Option 4 are fabricated and nonsensical distractors.
• Option 2 is Correct because Bihar records the highest livestock density per square kilometer among Indian states, driven by intensive smallholder mixed farming and dense rural human populations.

Examiner trap: Distinguish clearly between Total Livestock Population (led by Uttar Pradesh and Rajasthan) and Livestock Density per square kilometer (where Bihar records the highest concentration).

e:
The official Quinquennial Livestock Census conducted by the Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying enumerates species-wise animal populations across all Indian states.

• Statement 1 is Correct because, as per the 20th Livestock Census (2019), Uttar Pradesh leads in Total Livestock (67.8 million), followed by Rajasthan (56.8 million) and Madhya Pradesh (40.6 million).
• Statement 2 is Correct because in specific Cattle (cow/bull) population alone, West Bengal holds the #1 rank (19.0 million), overtaking Uttar Pradesh (18.8 million) and Madhya Pradesh (18.7 million).
• Statement 3 is Incorrect because India has the world's largest bovine inventory, with total cattle stock standing at 192.49 million heads in 2019.

Examiner trap: Be careful with 20th Livestock Census categories: Total Livestock = Uttar Pradesh is #1; Cattle (Cows/Bulls) = West Bengal is #1; Buffaloes = Uttar Pradesh is #1; Sheep = Telangana is #1; Goats = Rajasthan is #1.

qe: A caprine physiology manual tracks the daily fluid yield limits and commercial utility configurations of different indigenous goat breeds. Which strain records the absolute highest milk yielding capability in India?
qh: प्रारूप B: एक बकरी (caprine) शरीर क्रिया विज्ञान मैनुअल विभिन्न स्वदेशी बकरी की नस्लों के दैनिक तरल उपज सीमाओं और वाणिज्यिक उपयोग विन्यासों को ट्रैक करता है। भारत में कौन सी नस्ल पूर्ण रूप से उच्चतम दूध देने की क्षमता दर्ज करती है?
oe: The Bhadawari line, which is a mobile floating sand sheet anchored within the interior sand dunes of the Thar desert.
Jamunapari, which operates as a dual-purpose breed for both milk and meat, producing an expansive baseline of 2.5 to 3.0 kg of milk per day.
The Murrah strain, which functions textually as a wild mammalian flying predator that rejects any liquid milk synthesis.
The Hallikar breed, which is an artificial concrete tower built manually by aerospace boundary defense networks in Punjab.
oh: भदावरी नस्ल, जो थार में एक तैरती रेत संरचना है।
जमुनापारी (Jamunapari), जो दूध और मांस दोनों के लिए एक द्विकाजी नस्ल है, जो प्रतिदिन 2.5 से 3.0 किग्रा दूध का उत्पादन करती है।
मुर्रा नस्ल, जो एक उड़ने वाला शिकारी जीव है।
हल्लीकर नस्ल, जो कंक्रीट का टावर है।
e:
Goats (Capra hircus) are dual-purpose livestock providing meat (Chevon) and milk, particularly suited to arid and semi-arid marginal farming systems.

• Option 1 is Incorrect because Bhadawari is a high-fat buffalo breed native to the Chambal ravines.
• Option 2 is Correct because Jamunapari (native to the ravines of Etawah, Uttar Pradesh) is the tallest, largest, and highest milk-yielding indigenous goat breed in India, producing 2.5–3.0 kg milk/day with distinctive Roman noses and long pendulous ears.
• Option 3 is Incorrect because Murrah is an elite buffalo breed.
• Option 4 is Incorrect because Hallikar is a celebrated draught cattle breed native to Karnataka.

Examiner trap: Remember key Indian Goat Breeds: Jamunapari = Highest milk yield (Etawah, UP); Barbari = City/Stall-fed dairy breed (dual-purpose); Black Bengal = Prolific meat and high-grade leather/skin breed; Pashmina/Chegu = Fine undercoat fleece (Chanthangi/Ladakh).
